Rust standard library (std, core and alloc), compiled into v86.wasm and
v86-fallback.wasm by the v86 build. Built from the Rust toolchain at commit
58cf8f9c35b355199727627d07ae34a4e2846d67.

text, taken from the Rust repository at that commit, follows.
